coach.title: AI Coach
coach.subtitle: Your coach analyzes your data and explains every piece of advice.

observation.early: Early chronotype — you sleep on average from {{bedtime}} to {{wake}}.
observation.intermediate: Intermediate chronotype — you sleep on average from {{bedtime}} to {{wake}}.
observation.late: Late chronotype — you sleep on average from {{bedtime}} to {{wake}}.

analysis.jetlag: Your weekday/weekend social jetlag is {{jetlagMin}} min. The more regular your schedule, the more stable your internal clock.
analysis.nights: Computed from your last {{nights}} nights. The more regular your schedule, the more stable your internal clock.

profile.action: To aim for {{hours}} h, go to bed around {{bedtime}} and keep your wake time around {{wake}}.

week.empty: You haven't logged any activity this week. Once you add some, I can analyze your load and consistency.

summary.up: This week: {{count}} activity(ies) over {{days}} day(s), {{totalMin}} min total. Your load is climbing sharply.
summary.down: This week: {{count}} activity(ies) over {{days}} day(s), {{totalMin}} min total. Your load is decreasing.
summary.balanced: This week: {{count}} activity(ies) over {{days}} day(s), {{totalMin}} min total. Your load is balanced.

analysis.highLoad: Your recent load is high, so this fatigue makes sense.
analysis.normal: Recovery is a core part of progress.

fatigue.action: Prioritize rest or a light mobility session today.

lowActivity.observation: You've been active {{days}} day(s) over the last 4 weeks.
lowActivity.action: Aim for 3 sessions a week before increasing intensity.

stagnating.observation: Your consistency is good but your performance is stalling.
stagnating.analysis: The body adapts: without a new stimulus, progress slows down.
stagnating.action: Vary your exercises or slightly increase load/volume.

plan.observation: Your current load gives an acute/chronic ratio of {{ratio}}.
plan.analysis: I'm adapting the difficulty to your current load state.

action.recovery: I suggest a recovery session (mobility, walking, light cardio).
action.intense: I suggest a more intense session to rebuild your load.
action.balanced: I suggest a balanced session in line with your program.

coach.help: I'm your Supotsu coach. I can analyze your week, tell you what to do today, adapt your session to your fatigue, and help if you're stuck. Ask me a question or pick a suggestion.

reached.analysis: You completed the challenge in time.
reached.action: Aim for the top of the leaderboard or start a new challenge.

pending.analysis: {{daysLeft}} day(s) left to finish the challenge.

action.pace: Plan for about {{perDay}} per day to make it.
action.over: The period is over: join a new challenge.

readyToTrain.analysis: Your body is ready to handle a demanding session.
readyToTrain.action: Make the most of it with an intense or quality session.

limitedData.analysis: Without recent health or activity data, the picture stays partial.
limitedData.action: Import your Garmin export or add an activity for a full picture.

observation.risk: Your acute/chronic load ratio is {{ratio}} (risk zone).

load.analysis: Compares your load over the last 7 days to your average over the last 4 weeks.

action.underLoad: You can gradually increase volume this week.
action.optimal: Well-balanced load: keep up this steady progression.
action.high: Load rising fast — watch your recovery before adding more.
action.risk: Load spike: ease off a bit this week to limit injury risk.

analysis.default: Default pick: complete your profile for a personalized recommendation.
analysis.goalAndAvailability: Matches your goal and weekly availability.
analysis.profileAndAvailability: Matches your profile and weekly availability.

marketplace.action: Open the program to see its structure before signing up.

noWeight.analysis: Without a weight, needs are approximated with average values.
noWeight.action: Add your weight to your profile for personalized targets.

targets.analysis: Based on standard ratios (protein g/kg, hydration, calorie intake).
targets.action: Adjust them based on your hunger, energy, and how your weight evolves.

lowProtein.observation: You're at {{proteinG}} g of protein ({{proteinPct}}% of your target).
lowProtein.analysis: Low protein intake slows recovery and muscle maintenance.
lowProtein.action: Add a protein source to your next meal (eggs, fish, legumes).

lowHydration.observation: Hydration at {{hydrationMl}} ml ({{hydrationPct}}% of your target).
lowHydration.analysis: Insufficient hydration hurts alertness and performance.
lowHydration.action: Drink a glass of water now and keep a bottle handy.

onTrack.observation: {{kcal}} kcal and {{proteinG}} g of protein today.
onTrack.analysis: Your intake is consistent with your estimated targets.
onTrack.action: Keep it up; adjust if your hunger or energy changes.

observation.faible: Estimated energy for tomorrow: {{energyScore}}/100 (low fatigue risk).
observation.modéré: Estimated energy for tomorrow: {{energyScore}}/100 (moderate fatigue risk).
observation.élevé: Estimated energy for tomorrow: {{energyScore}}/100 (high fatigue risk).

prediction.analysis: Estimated from your recent trajectory. This is a probability, not a certainty.
prediction.analysisWithAvg: Estimated from your recent trajectory. Your recent average is {{avgSleepHours}} h/night. This is a probability, not a certainty.

action.low: Good day for it: consider a demanding session if one's planned.
action.moderate: Aim for moderate intensity and monitor how you feel while warming up.
action.high: Prioritize recovery: active rest, mobility, and an early bedtime tonight.

acwrRisk.title: Ease your load this week
acwrRisk.observation: Your acute/chronic load ratio is {{ratio}} (risk zone).
acwrRisk.analysis: A rapid load increase significantly raises injury risk.
acwrRisk.action: Cut volume by ~20% and keep one easy session to absorb the spike.

lowRecovery.title: Prioritize recovery
lowRecovery.analysis: Your body hasn't yet absorbed recent load (sleep, HRV, HR).
lowRecovery.action: Aim for active rest or mobility today, not intensity.

poorSleep.title: Catch up on sleep
poorSleep.analysis: Poor sleep hurts recovery, mood, and performance.
poorSleep.action: Go to bed 30–60 min earlier tonight and cut screens before bed.

lowWellness.title: Take care of your mind
lowWellness.analysis: Stress and mental fatigue weigh as much as physical fatigue.
lowWellness.action: Give yourself a real break: a few minutes of breathing or a walk.

roomToPush.title: You can pick up the load
roomToPush.analysis: You're below your usual level and well recovered — there's room.
roomToPush.action: Add a bit of volume or intensity, gradually.

allGood.title: Everything's green — keep going
allGood.observation: Your indicators are in good ranges today.
allGood.analysis: Nothing calls for a particular adjustment.
allGood.action: Stick to your plan and keep the consistency — that's what pays off.

noData.title: Add data for a recommendation
noData.analysis: Log an activity or connect a device.
noData.action: Come back here once you've tracked a few days.

recovery.analysis: Computed from your sleep, HRV and heart rate.

action.excellent: Your body is ready: an intense session fits well.
action.correct: A normal workout is recommended today.
action.moyen: Adjust intensity: favor technique or moderate volume.
action.faible: Prioritize recovery: mobility or active rest.

observation.up: Your training load is climbing {{pct}}%/week on average over {{weeks}} weeks.
observation.down: Your training load is dropping {{pct}}%/week on average over {{weeks}} weeks.

analysis.up: Progressive overload is in place — good for continued gains.
analysis.down: A declining load slows progress, unless this is a planned deload week.
analysis.stable: Your load is stable — neither clear progress nor regression.

action.up: Keep this momentum going, while watching your recovery.
action.down: If this isn't a planned recovery week, increase volume slightly.
action.stable: Add a bit of volume or load to restart progress.

analysis.balanced: All three components are in a solid range.

weak.progression: Aim for a small load or volume increase this week.
weak.regularity: Add a session this week to get back into a regular rhythm.
weak.performance: Ease back in — one more session this week will restart your momentum.

lowRecovery.analysis: Training hard on low recovery slows down progress.
lowRecovery.action: Today's priority: rest or light mobility.

noActivity.observation: No activity logged in the last 7 days.
noActivity.analysis: Your consistency is dipping — the hardest part is starting again.
noActivity.action: Plan a light session today to restart momentum.

highLoad.observation: Your recent load is clearly above your usual.
highLoad.analysis: A too-fast increase raises the risk of fatigue and injury.
highLoad.action: Prioritize active recovery or mobility today.

roomToPush.observation: Your load is dropping while your consistency stays good.
roomToPush.analysis: Your body has room to take on more.
roomToPush.action: You can plan a slightly more intense session.

balanced.observation: You've been active {{days}} day(s) over the last 7.
balanced.analysis: Your load and consistency are well balanced.
balanced.action: Keep this pace up, progress is sustainable.

observation.excellent: Your sleep score is {{score}}/100 (excellent), for your night.
observation.correct: Your sleep score is {{score}}/100 (good), for your night.
observation.moyen: Your sleep score is {{score}}/100 (average), for your night.
observation.faible: Your sleep score is {{score}}/100 (low), for your night.

withHours.excellent: Your sleep score is {{score}}/100 (excellent), for {{hours}} h.
withHours.correct: Your sleep score is {{score}}/100 (good), for {{hours}} h.
withHours.moyen: Your sleep score is {{score}}/100 (average), for {{hours}} h.
withHours.faible: Your sleep score is {{score}}/100 (low), for {{hours}} h.

score.analysis: Computed from the duration and efficiency of your last night.

action.excellent: Keep it up: this rhythm supports your recovery well.
action.correct: Good sleep — aim for regular bedtimes.
action.moyen: Try going to bed 30 min earlier tonight.
action.faible: Short night: ease off intensity and prioritize sleep today.

allGood.analysis: All measured components are in the green.
allGood.action: Keep it up: maintain this steady rhythm to consolidate your recovery.

analysis.single: This score seems mainly tied to one factor below — a correlation observed in your data, not a certainty.
analysis.multi: This score seems mainly tied to the factors below — a correlation observed in your data, not a certainty.

action.quantity: Aim for 30 to 60 min more sleep: go to bed a bit earlier tonight.
action.quality: For quality: limit screens and alcohol in the evening, and keep the room cool and dark.
action.regularity: Aim for a stable bedtime window (±30 min), weekends included.
action.debt: Debt built up over several months: catch up gradually (30-60 min more sleep per night, over several weeks), not all at once.
action.recovery: Low recovery: ease off intensity today and favor active rest.

wellness.analysis: Based on your mood, energy, and stress felt today.

action.rayonnant: Great energy — make the most of it for what matters.
action.stable: Everything's fine: keep the routines that do you good.
action.fragile: Give yourself a break: a few minutes of breathing can help.
action.difficile: Demanding day — be kind to yourself and prioritize rest.
